text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
It's the peak of summer.
{0} is called out by Maho while in the middle of a walk,
which leads him to Caon's guildhouse.
text_block_list.orig_text:
夏も真っ盛りのある日、
{0}は散歩していたところをマホに呼ばれて、
【自警団（カォン）】のギルドハウスにやってきていた。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Don't be moving now, my prince.
text_block_list.orig_text:
王子はん、
ちょっと動かんといてな～

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
What're you up to, Princess?
Sure looks like you're tying him up real good with that rope.
text_block_list.orig_text:
何やってんだ
姫さん？
{0}を紐みたいなもんで縛り上げて。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
That's an awful way to put it, Makoto.
This is measurin' tape, not a rope.
text_block_list.orig_text:
マコトはん、
人聞きの悪い表現を
せんでもらえます？
これは紐やのうて
メジャーです。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Urgh...
text_block_list.orig_text: ううう……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Ohh. Taking his measurements, are you?
Which means you're making some new clothes.
Dunno how you can bother when it's this hot.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
体の寸法を測ってんのか。
てことは
また服でも仕立てるのか？
この夏の暑い日に、
マメだねぇ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Aye, that's about the gist of it.
Doesn't matter if it's hot or cold, though. This is just what I do.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁ、
そんなところやね。
こういうことに
暑いも寒いも
関係ありまへんよ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Watch out, {0}.
There's no denying she makes some great quality gear,
but, well... expect frills. Lots of frills.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも気を付けろよ{0}。
姫さんの作る服はすげぇ出来はいいんだけど、
その……
フリフリ、
だからな。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Frilly clothes are mighty cute, after all.
But Makoto here never ever wears them.
She's such a meanie.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒラヒラしてるの
かいらしやないの。
せやのに
マコトはん、
ちっとも着てくれへんのやもん。
いけずやわぁ。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Urghhh...
text_block_list.orig_text: うううううう……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Come on. You know that sort of stuff doesn't suit me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
だってあたしには
ああいうの似合わないしさ……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
What?! N-no way!
I'm not... Oh! Ask Yui to wear some for you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ！？
　
いっ、いやダメだ！
そういうのは……
そうだ、
ユイにでも見せてもらえ！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Come now, Makoto. No need to be scared.
He's real curious, ya know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええやないの
マコトはん、
着て見せてぇな。
王子はんも
見たい言うてはるよ？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Stop instigating! And quit trying to strip me down, too!
Hey, you! You better look away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やめろって姫さん！
　脱がそうとすんな！
おまえは向こう向いてろ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Urghhhhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ううううううううう～っ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I wanna go to the beach!
text_block_list.orig_text: 海に行きたいさ～！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Whoa?! You scared the life outta me!
What's all the moaning and groaning about?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うおぉビックリした！？
なんか唸ってると思ったら
いきなりどうしたカオリ！？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I can't hold it in anymore!
Look outside! The sun's shining nice and bright,
but I'm stuck inside! It's such a waste!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう我慢できないさ～！
外を見てよ～！
　てぃーだも輝いてるのに、
部屋の中でゴロゴロしてるなんて
もったいないよ～！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
We've had an awful lot of indoor security work, too.
Guess that's been a li'l bit stressful for you, hasn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
最近は
室内の警備仕事も多かったし、
カオリはんには
ストレスためさせてしもたかもなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I wanna swim as far as I can!
I wanna run along the beach!
I wanna dance anywhere and everywhere!
text_block_list.orig_text:
海で思いっきり泳ぎたいさ～！
浜辺を走り回りたいさ～！
どこでもそこでも踊りたいさ～！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Uh, I'm pretty sure you've been getting your fill of that last one.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
最後のはいつもやってるだろ……？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Well, if it's the beach you want, it's the beach you get.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほんなら、
いきましょか？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text: え？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text: え？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Truth is, I figured y'all would be feeling some burnout,
so I planned on taking us all on a li'l trip.
text_block_list.orig_text:
実はねぇ。
そろそろみんなも
疲れてるやろ思て、
旅行にでも行こう思うてたんよ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
For real? Dang, Princess.
You sure know how to come out with a great surprise!
text_block_list.orig_text:
マジかよ、
姫さん……
すげぇサプライズじゃねぇか！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: You're the best, Maho!
text_block_list.orig_text:
マホ、
大好きさ～！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
It's not just us, either.
The little ones oughtta get out now and then as well.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに、
あの子たちも
たまにはお外の風を浴びんとな？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: The little ones?
text_block_list.orig_text: ……あの子たち？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: And thus it was decided that Caon would go to the beach, fulfilling Kaori's desire.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうしてカオリの願望はかない、
【自警団（カォン）】の面々は夏の海へと旅行に行くことになった。
